title: Solution structure, oxidative DNA damage, biological activity and molecular docking of ternary copper(II) L-argininato complexes.
authors: Wojciechowska, Agnieszka; Bregier Jarzebowska, Romualda; Komarnicka, Urszula K; Szuster Ciesielska, Agnieszka; Sulek, Michal; Bojarska Junak, Agnieszka; Ramadan, Ramadan M; Jezierska, Julia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜(II)-L-精氨酸配合物与DNA的相互作用及分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模，但核心是金属药物设计而非TF-DNA转录结合机制，方法上仅用简单对接，深度不足。
abstract: Continuing our search for metal drugs with markedly higher toxicity to cancer cells than to normal cells, we evaluated the effect of 2,2'-bipyridine (bpy) as a co-ligand in the compounds [Cu(mu-O,O'-NO(3))(L-Arg)(bpy)]NO(3)(n) (1) and [CuCl(L-Arg)(bpy)]Cl.3H(2)O (2) (L-Arg = L-arginine), on DNA interaction, cytotoxic and antiproliferative activity, compared to the effects induced by other co-ligands i.e. 1,10-phenanthroline (phen) and SCN(-) ions, in similar Cu(II) compounds we have studied previously. Potentiometric, X-band EPR and UV-Vis experiments were first used to structurally characterise the complexes formed in solutions 1 and 2 and in model Cu(II)/bpy/L-Arg systems. Gel electrophoresis in the presence of H(2)O(2) was used to identify DNA damage by 1 and 2. In addition, cyclic voltammetry of both compounds was performed to confirm the existence of Cu(II)/Cu(I) redox pairs involved in the free radical mechanism of this DNA damage. The DNA binding constants of 1 and 2 were determined spectrophotometrically. The selectivity of the cytotoxic and antiproliferative activity of compounds 1 and 2 was tested in vitro against human lung adenocarcinoma (A549), liver cancer (HepG2) and normal cells in comparison with those previously observed by us for compounds consisting of phen and SCN(-) ligands. Molecular docking calculations were performed for [Cu(L-Arg)(bpy)](2+) species (arraised in solutions of 1 and 2) interacting with B-DNA (aureolin), metalloproteinase (S. aureus) and penicillin-binding protein (E. coli) to determine the nature of the complex-receptor interaction, potential binding modes and energies.
abstract_zh: 在我们继续寻找对癌细胞毒性显著高于正常细胞的金属药物的过程中，我们评估了2,2'-联吡啶（bpy）作为辅助配体在化合物[Cu(mu-O,O'-NO(3))(L-Arg)(bpy)]NO(3)(n) (1)和[CuCl(L-Arg)(bpy)]Cl.3H(2)O (2)（L-Arg = L-精氨酸）中对DNA相互作用、细胞毒性和抗增殖活性的影响，并与我们先前研究的类似Cu(II)化合物中其他辅助配体（即1,10-菲咯啉（phen）和SCN(-)离子）所诱导的效果进行了比较。首先使用电位滴定、X波段EPR和UV-Vis实验对溶液1和2以及模型Cu(II)/bpy/L-Arg系统中形成的配合物进行了结构表征。在H(2)O(2)存在下使用凝胶电泳来鉴定1和2引起的DNA损伤。此外，对两种化合物进行了循环伏安法，以确认参与该DNA损伤自由基机制的Cu(II)/Cu(I)氧化还原对的存在。通过分光光度法测定了1和2的DNA结合常数。化合物1和2的细胞毒性和抗增殖活性的选择性在体外针对人肺腺癌（A549）、肝癌（HepG2）和正常细胞进行了测试，并与我们先前观察到的含有phen和SCN(-)配体的化合物的结果进行了比较。对[Cu(L-Arg)(bpy)](2+)物种（在溶液1和2中形成）与B-DNA（金丝桃素）、金属蛋白酶（金黄色葡萄球菌）和青霉素结合蛋白（大肠杆菌）的相互作用进行了分子对接计算，以确定复合物-受体相互作用的性质、潜在结合模式和能量。
